title: Over a hundred crash retrieval cases in Majic Eyes Only

tellings.quote: look at Ryan S. Wood's fantastic book, Magic Eyes Only, we can find over a hundred cases of of UFO crash retrieval.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that a book called Majic Eyes Only, by the writer Ryan S. Wood, lists more than a hundred cases of UFO crash retrieval, meaning the recovery of crashed craft. UAPGerb calls it a fantastic book and points to it in passing, without going through the cases. If those cases hold up, crashed craft would be far from a one-off event.
